setups.setup: Parabolic — risk warning on a long

checks.rule: Vertical run: ≥ 50% in days to weeks
3+ up days in a row into the top
Far above its rising averages (rare-air multiple of the daily range)
First crack: big red bar on the latest session

setups.note: A risk flag on a long, never a short call. The handbook: 'I do not short strength.'

checks.rule: Pole is a staircase, not a near-vertical blow-off
Pole is not one big spike day
Flag is shallow: ≤ 20-25% off the pole high
Flag is brief: 3-5 weeks, not much past 8
Flag is tight: volume fading through it
Flag is quieter than the pole
Narrow days into the buy point
First or second flag of the run
